scenes.line1: How do you avoid messy APIs?
scenes.say: How do you avoid messy APIs and make sure everyone’s on the same page? Ever heard of contract-first design?

scenes.label: OpenAPI
scenes.sub: Describes REST APIs in a standard format.
scenes.say: OpenAPI, also known as Swagger, describes REST APIs in a standard, machine-readable format.
With contract-first, you write the OpenAPI spec first, share it for agreement, generate code and docs, then build your API to match.

scenes.question: Why do interviewers love contract-first?
scenes.right: It ensures clarity, maintainability, and enables code generation and documentation.
scenes.say: Why do interviewers love contract-first design? It’s not just about speed—it’s about clarity, maintainability, and powerful tooling.
